title: The Lava World Under Rock Desert City
summary: Qing Lin leads Xiao Yan and the Desert Metal Mercenary Company down a passage under Rock Desert City into a vast underground magma world. The mercenaries turn back in the heat, and Xiao Yan flies on over the lava on his own. A Two-Headed Flame Spirit Serpent attacks him, then tries to grab Qing Lin, but she forms a contract with it. Yao Lao explains that Qing Lin has the Jade Snake Three Flower Pupils, the natural nemesis of snake-type beasts. The serpent shows that the Heavenly Flame lies below the magma, so Xiao Yan dives in, shielded by Yao Lao's Bone Chilling Flame for less than an hour. They find a thousand-year-old green lotus, but the Green Lotus Core Flame is gone. A scale left behind belongs to the Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python of Queen Medusa, so Xiao Yan decides to go to the depths of the Tager Desert.
events: The group follows Qing Lin's senses down the passage; most mercenaries turn back in the heat.
Xiao Yan flies over the lava with his wings; Xiao Ding asks if he has become a Dou Wang.
A Two-Headed Flame Spirit Serpent attacks Xiao Yan and then goes for Qing Lin.
Qing Lin forms a contract with the serpent; Yao Lao names her Jade Snake Three Flower Pupils.
The serpent reveals the Heavenly Flame is hidden below the magma.
Xiao Yan dives into the lava inside Yao Lao's Bone Chilling Flame shield, with under an hour to spare.
They find the green lotus, but the Green Lotus Core Flame has been taken.
A Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python scale points to Queen Medusa; they head for the depths of the Tager Desert.
